addressing:
  loopbacks:
  - id: node_loopbacks
    applies_to:
      any:
      - segment: leo_a
      - segment: leo_b
      - segment: heo_relay
      - segment: geo_relay
      - segment: luna_relay
      - segment: leo_a_ground
      - segment: leo_b_ground
      - segment: heo_ground
      - segment: geo_ground
      - segment: luna_ground
    ipv4_pool: 10.255.0.0/16
    prefix_length: 32
    allocation: by_node_order
routing:
  domains:
  - id: earth_domain
    protocol: isis
    capabilities:
      mpls: {}
      segment_routing:
        data_plane: mpls
    selectors:
    - any:
      - segment: leo_a
      - segment: leo_b
      - segment: meo
      - segment: heo_relay
      - segment: geo_relay
      - segment: leo_a_ground
      - segment: leo_b_ground
      - segment: heo_ground
      - segment: geo_ground
    area_assignment:
      strategy: flat
  - id: luna_domain
    protocol: isis
    selectors:
    - any:
      - segment: luna_relay
      - segment: luna_ground
    area_assignment:
      strategy: flat
  boundaries:
  - over: geo_to_luna
    adapter: static_ip
    export:
    - from: earth_domain
      to: luna_domain
      prefixes:
        aggregate_of: originated
      export_node_loopbacks: true
      install_via: peer_loopback
    - from: luna_domain
      to: earth_domain
      prefixes:
        aggregate_of: originated
      export_node_loopbacks: true
      install_via: peer_loopback
simulation:

ephemeris:
